scripts.dev:server:client: cd server-app && cross-env CLIENT_BUILD=true pnpm run dev
scripts.build:server:client: cd server-app && cross-env CLIENT_BUILD=true pnpm run build
scripts.release:client: bash scripts/verify-client-build.sh && pnpm build:client && cross-env CLIENT_BUILD=true pnpm build:server:client && bash scripts/verify-client-build.sh && bash scripts/generate-build-report.sh
scripts.install:all: cd client-app && pnpm install && cd ../server-app && pnpm install && cd ../license-center-app && pnpm install
